title: Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe available for Real Sociedad match despite knee discomfort
content:
Real Madrid head coach Alvaro Arbeloa says Kylian Mbappe will be available for Saturday’s La Liga game against Real Sociedad.

Mbappe, 27, has been struggling with discomfort in his left knee since December and was absent from training on Thursday, but speaking at his pre-match press conference Arbeloa said: “Kylian is fine. He has trained with the group and is available for tomorrow’s game.”

The coach also addressed the situation around Madrid captain Dani Carvajal, who has only played 29 minutes in two appearances in 2026 despite having recovered from his latest knee injury.

Arbeloa downplayed reports of a key meeting with Carvajal, saying that he had spoken to the right-back “as with all the players”.

He added: “I like to talk to them individually and I take advantage of every week to talk to all of them. I have a very comfortable gray sofa where we sit and talk.”

The Athletic reported on Monday that the right-back is upset about his lack of playing time, and there are doubts about the renewal of his contract, which expires in June.

Arbeloa also spoke positively about the team dinner organised by Madrid’s players during the week at a restaurant partly owned by Vinicius Junior.

“I like to see them united, it’s one of the things I’ve insisted on the most,” he said. “Seeing them have dinner together makes me very happy. I miss it from my playing days. Cristiano (Ronaldo) also came a lot.”

Madrid are second in La Liga, one point behind Barcelona, and will host Real Sociedad on Saturday without the injured Eder Militao, Jude Bellingham, and Rodrygo.

The Basque team are eighth in the table and are yet to lose in nine games in all competitions under new American coach Pellegrino Matarazzo.
